sentences.text: Yangon -LRB- ရန က န , MLCTS rankun mrui , -LSB- jàɴɡòʊɴ mjo̰ -RSB- ; formerly known as Rangoon , literally : `` End of Strife '' -RRB- is the capital of the Yangon Region of Myanmar , also known as Burma .	Myanmar	Myanmar	Region	Administrative divisions of Myanmar	Yangon Region	Yangon Region

Yangon served as the capital of Myanmar until 2006 , when the military government relocated the capital to the purpose-built city of Naypyidaw in central Myanmar .	Myanmar	Myanmar	capital of Myanmar	capital of Myanmar	military government	State Peace and Development Council	Naypyidaw	Naypyidaw
With over 7 million people , Yangon is Myanmar 's largest city and is its most important commercial centre .	Myanmar	Myanmar
Yangon boasts the largest number of colonial-era buildings in the region , and has a unique colonial-era urban core that is remarkably intact .
The colonial-era commercial core is centred around the Sule Pagoda , which reputed to be over 2,000 years old .	Sule Pagoda	Sule Pagoda
The city is also home to the gilded Shwedagon Pagoda -- Myanmar 's most sacred Buddhist pagoda .	Shwedagon Pagoda	Shwedagon Pagoda	Myanmar	Myanmar
The mausoleum of the last Mughal Emperor is located in Yangon , where he had been exiled following the Indian Mutiny of 1857 .	Mughal	Mughal Empire	Indian Mutiny	Indian Rebellion of 1857
Yangon suffers from deeply inadequate infrastructure , especially compared to other major cities in Southeast Asia .	Southeast Asia	Southeast Asia

Though many historic residential and commercial buildings have been renovated throughout central Yangon , most satellite towns that ring the city continue to be profoundly impoverished and lack basic infrastructure .
